prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1382
Claimant:
Robert Wolf
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
18 Mar 2025
Claim received for a side impact at an intersection involving the insured's vehicle and a second vehicle. The claimant
reports neck and back strain and is not represented by an attorney.
10 May 2025
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of the loss. Requested the
police report and statements from the other driver.
20 Jun 2025
The police report and the other drvier both confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision, and the
accuont of how the crash happened matches what was reported at first notice.
29 Jun 2025
Reviewed scene photos and spoke with two witnesses. Both describe the collision in the same way the claimant did,
and the photos show damage that is mostly consistent with the described impact.
5 Sep 2025
Spoke with the claimant by phone. The account of the crash was the same as in the initial report, with no changes in
sequence or detail.
8 Sep 2025
Inspected the vehicle with the appraiser. The damage pattern lines up well with a side impact of this type, and no prior
damage to the vehicle is known from our records or prior claims history.
9 Sep 2025
A neighbor contacted the office and stated the car looked damaged a few weeks before the reported loss. This has
been noted and will be followed up, though the neighbor did not provide specifics about what was seen.
12 Sep 2025
Reviewed the medical records. The reported neck and back strain fits the kind and force of the crash, and no earlier
injury to the same body areas is on file.
8 Oct 2025
Treatment followed a typical course and tapered as the claimant improved, with notes showing steady progress at
each follow-up visit.
24 Oct 2025
Reviewed the file with the team lead. The neighbor's comment is the only open item; the rest of the information
supports the claim as reported, and the file will be updated once the follow-up is complete.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
